description: This file defines a custom attribute 'TestCategoryAttribute' and a 'CategoryDiscoverer' for use with xUnit testing framework. It provides a way to categorize tests similarly to MSTest's [TestCategory], using [Trait("Category", ...)]. The file also includes informative comments explaining the purpose and usage.

classes.name: TestCategoryAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute to assign a category to test classes or methods, mimicking MSTest's TestCategoryAttribute.

classes.name: CategoryDiscoverer
classes.description: Class implementing ITraitDiscoverer, used by xUnit to discover 'Category' traits based on the custom attribute.

methods.name: TestCategoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor accepting a category string, used to assign the category.

methods.name: CategoryDiscoverer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the discoverer with a diagnostic message sink.

methods.name: GetTraits
methods.description: Method returning key-value pairs representing the test category trait for xUnit to filter tests.
